name: String builder
description: Render a fixed-width text report by concatenating lines with += in a loop.
fixture_description: rows: n_rows (name, quantity, price) tuples; names are 1..max_name_length ASCII letters, quantities 0..9999, prices 0..10000 rounded to 4 decimals.

expected_output.description: One line per row: name left-aligned in 12 columns, quantity right-aligned in 6, price with 2 decimals right-aligned in 12.

suspected_bottleneck: `report += line` in a loop may copy the growing string (O(n^2)) unless CPython resizes it in place.
